Specifically, I must examine whether the natural elements described—wind, waves, lightning, rain, dark clouds, and the effect of the storm on people seeking shelter—align logically and consistently with one another. I must look for:

- Contradictions in the natural behavior of the elements (e.g., if the text suggests that lightning does not behave as it typically does during a storm).
- Logical inconsistencies in cause and effect (e.g., if the text claims the storm brought light to the night, I must determine if that is a logical outcome of the storm).
- Any illogical or contradictory descriptions of the environment or actions of the people within it.

I must report any inconsistencies clearly and concisely, explaining why they are problematic. If no inconsistencies are found, I must state that the text is internally consistent.

I will base my analysis solely on the text provided and will not introduce external knowledge or assumptions beyond what is written.
